## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [白延](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E5%BB%B6) Bái Yán is the earliest Chinese version of the *Surata-paripṛcchā* — the Mahāyāna sūtra on the inquiry of the layman Surata. A parallel translation by [支施崙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0021) Zhī Shīlún (T0329) was produced shortly afterwards in the Former-Liáng state. Together with *[Ān Xuán's Fǎ jìng jīng / Ugra-paripṛcchā](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0014)*, the *Surata-paripṛcchā* is one of the foundational *paripṛcchā*-genre Mahāyāna sūtras.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [白延](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E5%BB%B6) Bái Yán's Cáo-Wèi period activity, c. 252 – 256 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō text (T0328) is established on the standard apparatus.
